title: Inpatient Death Summary and Handover
content:
SOP: Inpatient Death Summary and Handover (SOP-MRD-001)
DEPARTMENT: Medical Records (MRD / HIM)
VERSION: 2.3
ROLES: doctor, nurse, medical_records
PURPOSE: Clinical death certification and dignified mortuary handover.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Inpatient Death Summary and Handover in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Inpatient Death Summary and Handover in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Inpatient Death Summary and Handover in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Inpatient Death Summary and Handover in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Inpatient Death Summary and Handover in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Medical Records (MRD / HIM).
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-MRD-001 Inpatient Death Summary and Handover v2.3, Section 4
